text: Kigurumi Mask Maker List Kigurumi Mask Makers List Compiled by Celes Halcyon As service to the animegao kigurumi community, I have compiled this list of kigurumi mask makers from online information. This list includes both professional and hobbyist makers. Please note that this list is a living document and no information is guaranteed to be accurate. I make no representation as to the quality of the masks or the reputation of these makers. Some of the makers appear no longer active but are listed for informational purposes. The current version of this list was made available on December 10, 2025. Most of the information was progressively updated in September and October 2025. Some additional changes/updates were made in November and early December. If you have any comments on this list, please send a Twitter/X DM to @celeshalcyon or an e-mail to celes [at] kig-o.com. WARNING: Some links may lead to NSFW content, even if the comments do not mention this fact.
